_doc: Short in-engine cutscenes (StoryManager queue, CutscenePlayer). Each plays at most once per save, only in the clinic, before any queued conversation, and is skippable (ESC or SKIP; click or SPACE moves on). Acts queue cs_act_<n> when they begin; beats, story-case decisions and conversation effects can queue others ({"cutscene": id}). A shot: backdrop (keyart | clinic | street:<location id> | black), optional card (a chapter title), optional portrait (cast id) with expr, text (typed out), optional hold (seconds after the text, default from its length). Everything reuses existing art: the title key art, the clinic room, the street scenes (with today's weather) and the cast portraits.

shots.text: Caldera. The water came up, and the city went down to meet it.
Down here nobody has a licence. Everybody has chrome that needs fixing.
Kaspar's old storeroom, under the Sump. A table, a lamp, a drain in the floor. Rent due Friday.
Someone is already on the stairs.
Three cars in Rustline colours stop outside. Nobody gets out until she does.
Mother doesn't knock.
A name is a target.
Three people said your name this week. Two were patients. One was an inspector.
Power always asks for something back.
Up in Meridian Heights, someone has started counting your patients.
A car too clean for the Sump parks outside. The driver stays in. The passenger doesn't.
"Doctor. Thank you for making the time. Mine is billed."
Truth is expensive. So is silence.
Forty static cases. A trial buried in the Sump. A lattice with a part number.
Ilse holds her cup with both hands. It doesn't help. "Sit down. I owe you something."
Everything you did comes back.
The whole street knows your door now. Tonight they're all coming through it.
The lattice lies in a steel tray like a nest of grey hair. It's still warm.
Somewhere above the Sump, someone is singing. Badly. On purpose.
The car has no plates. The driver holds the door like a waiter.
Bed 14 waves from the back seat as it pulls away. Nobody waves from those cars.
